usage: Usually used as a noun for a colour name, e.g. 件衫係深紫色。
Can describe the colour of clothing, objects, or design choices, e.g. 佢揀咗深紫色嘅袋。
Often comes after 係 / 用嚟講外觀, e.g. 呢張卡紙係深紫色。
Can be modified by quantity words like 好 / 少少 to give a softer description, e.g. 佢想要深紫色少少。
